title: Mission Control header: fix button order, intents, and styling for operational clarity
goal: The Mission Control screen header has four action buttons with confusing order and styling: (1) 'View Agents ↗' — action danger (WRONG: this is navigation, not destructive), (2) 'Start Queued Checks' — action primary hidden (correct, contextual), (3) 'Kill Run' — action secondary (WRONG: this is destructive, should be action danger), (4) 'View Findings →' — action primary (correct), (5) 'Cinema Mode' — action secondary. Correct the CSS classes and reorder for operator clarity. Recommended order: [Kill Run (danger)] [Start Queued Checks (primary, contextual)] [View Findings (primary)] [View Agents (ghost/secondary)] [Cinema Mode (ghost)]. Destructive action (Kill Run) should be leftmost to prevent accidental clicks when scanning left to right.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: Mission Control header buttons have swapped danger/secondary classes (View Agents = danger but is navigation; Kill Run = secondary but is destructive). Button order puts the destructive action between two primary actions. This is confusing and increases accidental kill-run risk.
generation_reason: System review 2026-05-01: Mission Control button intent mismatch — View Agents is danger (wrong), Kill Run is secondary (wrong). Also wrong visual order.
